difficulty_reason: For every odd m, the author analyzes a theta quotient coming from an infinite extension of an affine vertex superalgebra, reduces its constant term through elliptic-function machinery, and identifies a weight m-1 polynomial in Eisenstein series at tau and m tau. The torsion-point formula is retained as supporting construction and is not split into another counted claim.
